defects.rule: Ruling 29: no silent loss of dictionary entries or references. coverage_check_stage4.py v2 (analyze_topic_pages.py, comparing deduplicated page-number SETS per topic) requires every page number recorded on a Topic's pageReferences to appear in the printed, ProcNumberLines-processed index text.
defects.observed: 29 of 934 Level-1 topics are each missing exactly ONE locator from the printed text vs. the Index.Topics data model (e.g. a-Анасуя loses page 595; a-Равана loses page 617; a-Будда loses page 597 while printed text shows a spurious extra page 456 not present in that topic's own reference set at all). Root-cause hypothesis (not yet confirmed): 693/934 topics carry one trailing PageReference whose sourceText throws 'Object is invalid' when re-queried post-ProcNumberLines (see TOPIC_PAGES_DUMP_v2.json) -- consistent with ProcNumberLines' native range-collapse consolidating/orphaning one reference object per topic; for 664/693 this is harmless (the orphaned ref's page number was already represented via a collapsed range), but for 29/693 the orphaned reference held the ONLY occurrence of a non-adjacent page number, which is then silently dropped from print instead of printing standalone. This is a live-InDesign ProcNumberLines behavior, not something introduced by index_letter.jsx or drive_proc_number_lines.py (which invokes the authorial palette unmodified, per H2589 guardrail).
defects.expected: Every page reference in the data model appears as a printed locator (bold-range/collapse formatting aside).
defects.ruling: MG 19-08-2026: accept as a known, narrow print-time defect rather than chase a fix inside ProcNumberLines; hand the exact 29-item list to the final proofreading pass instead. Does not gate continuing stage[4] (SplitStory/AddSeeTopic/HideShowNumber/AddAnnotationData).
defects.evidence: Litpam-Indexator/artifacts/print-readiness/book-II/pilot-2026/stage4/PAGE_SET_MISMATCHES_v2.json (29 concrete topic/page pairs), Litpam-Indexator/artifacts/print-readiness/book-II/pilot-2026/stage4/TOPIC_PAGES_DUMP_v2.json (raw per-reference COM read incl. the 693 trailing 'Object is invalid' entries), Litpam-Indexator/artifacts/print-readiness/book-II/pilot-2026/stage4/DFT-II-0003_PROOFREADING_LIST.md (the 29-row manual correction checklist for the proofreader).
